note: Fluid interactions (docs/CONTRACT.md Phase 6c slice VOC §2.5): vanilla conversions that change a block beside a fluid. Each row is probed in game (gate item 10, voc-probe, dev.vocab.probe {kind}); a row the probe contradicts is corrected here before the rule ships. `reach`: face (a face-adjacent cell), above (the cell directly above), taxicab n (cells within n steps through the fluid), or fire {side, below, above} (the reach M20 checks). `block`: a block, a #tag or a name ending in * (kit/lib/vocab.mjs hazardBlocks). `becomes`: the block that results ({col} the source's colour).

rows.why: vanilla ConcretePowderBlock: powder touching water on any face sets into concrete at once
vanilla SpongeBlock: a dry sponge beside water drains the water within 6 steps through the water, at most 64 cells, and turns wet (the draft assumed 7; voc-probe measured 6 and the cap)
vanilla MagmaBlock: water directly above becomes a downward bubble column
vanilla SoulSandBlock: water directly above becomes an upward bubble column
fire spreads to a flammable block within its reach (M20's reach, H's FIRE_REACH; the probe measures fire's own)
lava lights a flammable block within M20's reach (H's FIRE_REACH, from LavaFluid.randomTick; H's h-probe measured it)
